hints.title: Tracking Initial Activity Date
hints.text: Each participant logs multiple gameplay sessions across different dates. What summary metric identifies the earliest chronological occurrence for each player?

hints.title: Earliest Date Aggregation
hints.text: Group the session records by player identifier. Apply the min aggregate function to the event date to extract the premier login timestamp.

hints.title: Grouped Min Blueprint
hints.text: Formulate select player_id, min(event_date) as first_login from Activity group by player_id.

hints.title: Complete Implementation
hints.text:
```mysql
SELECT player_id, MIN(event_date) AS first_login
FROM Activity
GROUP BY player_id;
```

complexity.notes: Grouped aggregation finding minimum event date per player.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Correlated scalar subqueries scanning all records per player yield quadratic O(A * P) complexity.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Single-pass hash aggregation records minimum date per player in linear time.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Correct grouping on player_id and naming the output column first_login.

solutions.approach: Group By Player with Min Date
